instructions: README_START_HERE.md 27 October overrides applied. Native full-size PNGs only. No scale silhouettes on model sheets. Scene retains a drawn 178 cm scale person. Maximum five reference images; five tries per image.

images.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: approved-design creature model sheet, FIRST FRONT MASTER.
Canvas: exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape PNG. One creature only, no inset drawings.
Recipe: full-body front model sheet, neutral frontal camera with a slight downward view only enough to separate the coils; soft neutral studio key light from upper left. Flat uniform light-grey #E9E9EC background, no vignette, texture, scene, floor line or background gradient. A tiny unobtrusive contact shadow directly under the coils only.
Show the entire marsh serpent, raised hood and face viewed from the front, with its FULL long body arranged in two broad loose low coils beneath it. The tail tapers continuously to a single visible point. Keep the whole creature inside the canvas, filling almost the full height with a modest margin. The head and hood are an enlarged cobra-like flattened hood, not a dragon head. Exactly TWO smooth bone-white horns curve backward from the crown; no antlers, no other horns, no arms, legs or wings. Head, neck and body form one continuous plausible snake anatomy.
Actual design proportions: length 20 metres, main body diameter 1.5 metres, so total centreline length is about thirteen main-body diameters. The long loosely coiled trunk must remain visibly long and heavy; the raised neck tapers gradually into a proportionate hood. Do not make a short fat knotted snake. Broad simple dull-gold transverse bands wrap completely around jade-green scales and continue around the back and belly. Jade base #3E8A6E, shadow #2A5E4B; dull-gold bands #C9A34A. Use broad coherent hard cel-shadow shapes and selectively hand-inked scale rows with a few rough dry-brush edges, not a glossy rendered scale mesh. Pale muted ochre belly plates, harmonious with the gold bands.
Face: two narrow yellow eyes with BLACK VERTICAL SLIT pupils; mouth closed, predatory and cold. One SMALL black-violet #1A1026 Hush fissure on the centre of its brow, with only a few violet ash #6B4C9A flecks escaping. Preserve the face: never a hollow face-hole. A few sparse thin drawn steam curls rise from the hot body; any heat shimmer stays tiny and local immediately above it, with all ink contours crisp. There is no attack or supernatural aura.
No scale human, no silhouette, no ruler, no architecture, no additional creature, no decorative framing. This is the neutral design master from which later views must be drawn.

The marsh serpent: a giant serpent 20 m long with a body as thick as a small car, jade-green scales with dull gold bands, a hooded head with two backswept bone-white horns, yellow slit-pupil eyes, heat shimmer and steam rising from its body, and a small crack on its brow leaking violet ash.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
images.reason: Per-scale bevelled shading and rendered surface treatment fail strict drawn/cel check 11b.6.
